test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)

Option 1) WXT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b672ea10be75d7c167e29b5459d1ac6f67504d5ffbebe1904f4008d9f9b3d63.png] 

Option 2) **UWR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eede87fd4abc1f669137c5df554898072bc719808be0b373bb7fa7ce9fd60dfd.png] 

Option 3) STP
